pr_title: Read invoices back from the store

comments.comment: The change adds invoiceOf, a module-level free function that builds an Invoice from a stored row, though AGENTS.md says "`Invoice` is the domain object. Building an `Invoice` from anything else, such as a request body or a stored row, is a static factory on `Invoice`, as `Invoice.from(id, body)` is, never a free function. A free function is for a module-private helper that touches no domain object."
comments.failureScenario: invoiceOf builds an Invoice from an InvoiceRow as a free function in store.ts. AGENTS.md says "`Invoice` is the domain object. Building an `Invoice` from anything else, such as a request body or a stored row, is a static factory on `Invoice`, as `Invoice.from(id, body)` is, never a free function. A free function is for a module-private helper that touches no domain object." invoiceOf is module-private but constructs an Invoice, so the exemption does not cover it. A reader looking on Invoice for the ways to build one finds Invoice.from and not invoiceOf, and the next reader of rows writes a third.
